title: Filling the Basket
description: Fill the basket with food for the family

hints: Use 'cd my-house/kitchen' to go to your kitchen.

story: Let's look around to see what food is available in the kitchen.
hints: Use 'ls' to have a look around the kitchen.

story: Move three pieces of food into your basket.
You can move multiple items using 'mv item1 item2 item3 basket/'
For example: mv banana cake milk basket/
steps.objective: Move 3 food items into the basket
hints: Move food items like banana, cake, grapes, milk, pie, or sandwich into the basket
Use 'mv banana basket/' to move the banana
You need to move at least 3 food items
